newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Feb 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - Feb 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Moroccan banks to reduce interest rates for long-term investment loans by one percentage point as part of a promotional campaign from March 1 to end of December. The move follows guidelines issued by monetary authorities in early January.
- Brewery firm Brasseries du Maroc is to expand after it bought 80 percent of soft drinks company Societe Industrielle Marocaine (SIM).
- Privatisation Minister Abderrahman Saaidi says converting commercial and industrial public firms into limited companies likely to curb bad management.
- State-owned Office National des Aeroports (ONDA) is to devote 1.4 billion dirhams ($152 million) to upgrading airports so that they comply with international security norms.
- President of banks' association (GPBM) says difficult to bear effects of a deliberate decision to reduce interest rates on loans.
